season.source: Tide and stream: NOAA STOFS-2D-Global (Surge and Tide Operational Forecast System, ADCIRC), the nowcast for each hour. Wind and gusts: NOAA RTMA (Real-Time Mesoscale Analysis), Puerto Rico and Virgin Islands grid, 1.25 km, one analysis an hour. Both from NOAA Open Data on AWS.

forecast.source: Wind: NOAA NAM 3 km Puerto Rico nest 06z cycle of 09 Feb 2025. Tide: STOFS-2D-GLOBAL 12z cycle, its forecast at the mesh node nearest Road Town. Both as issued.

terrain.source: Terrarium elevation tiles (Mapzen, AWS Open Data).

wind.note: 10 m wind in tenths of a metre per second, blowing toward east (u) and north (v), and surface gust speed (g).
wind.modelled: wind shadow under the high islands and a little extra where the wind is squeezed past them are added by rule from the terrain

tide.note: Water level in metres above the model datum, close to mean sea level.
